verify_fix_path.note: v node independently recomputes; when v agrees with r (deployable), both usually right or share the same facts error

deployability: v_disagree = |v_value - r_value| beyond tolerance, computable from two model outputs without gold
tier: zero-call evaluation on frozen outputs; NEGATIVE/degenerate result reported honestly

honest_correction.finding: v disagreed with r on ALL 120 tasks and matched gold on 0/120: under the frozen 1e-4 relative tolerance the coder exact-value verifier is uninformative (constant-fire signal has recall 1.0 and precision equal to the 0.717 base rate - no discrimination), and the verify-fix path never fired. Root cause: free-form recompute without unit/scale conventions cannot hit a 1e-4-relative gold match.
honest_correction.consequence: a verifier-based deployable failure detector is NOT demonstrated; the only validated deployable signals remain parser/execution checks (precision 1.0, recall 33-39%). Any future verifier design must output the ranked expression or a scale-aware value and be re-evaluated.
honest_correction.impact_on_multidag_conclusion: none on the Static-vs-Dynamic contrast: the weak v node is symmetric across both arms; the measured Dynamic advantage comes from fallback/escalation adaptation and selective propagation, not from v fixing values.
